title: Camp Fire aerial footage from Cal Guard UH-60M Black Hawk: Nov. 15, 2018
description:
Aerial b-roll footage of a UH-60M Black Hawk helicopter from the California Army National Guard's 1st Assault Helicopter Battalion, 140th Aviation Regiment, flies over the Camp Fire in Butte County, California, Nov. 15, 2018. Crew chief and U.S. Army Sgt. Anthony Orduno is seen as the helicopter pulls out of a dip site.

The helicopter and crew are from Joint Forces Training Base, Los Alamitos, in Orange County, California.
